description: C# models for deserializing TITL PDF Processor API responses. Supports document extraction for deeds, mortgages, liens, title commitments, and 20+ property document types.
releaseNotes:
v3.0.0 (June 2026) — BREAKING (TSS export schema 2.0.0, ADR-030)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.0.0.
- BREAKING: TitleSearchSummaryExport.ChainOfTitle is removed and replaced by a
  single Runsheet (List<TssRunsheetEntry>) — the superset of every instrument
  tied to the property (deeds, mortgages, liens, releases, easements, ...), each
  tagged Present + Corroboration with per-evidence provenance. The processor does
  NOT derive a chain of title (the connected grantor->grantee ownership subset);
  deriving the chain from the runsheet is the consumer's responsibility.
- BREAKING: type TssChainOfTitleEntry renamed to TssRunsheetEntry (entry fields
  unchanged: Present, Corroboration, Position, evidence, etc.).
- BREAKING: TssExportCompleteness.HasChainOfTitle renamed to HasRunsheet.
- BREAKING: TssExportCompleteness.ChainGapCount renamed to ReferenceOnlyCount
  ("gap" dropped — it implied chain continuity the processor does not assert).
- Behavior: non-conveyance instruments (mortgages, releases, liens, easements)
  that were previously withheld from ChainOfTitle now appear in Runsheet, with
  Present=true and Corroboration corroborated/uncorroborated when a copy is in the
  package. Search work-products (TSS, runsheet, commitment), tax, parcel, and
  informational documents are not runsheet rows.
- Migration: rename ChainOfTitle -> Runsheet, HasChainOfTitle -> HasRunsheet,
  ChainGapCount -> ReferenceOnlyCount; TssChainOfTitleEntry -> TssRunsheetEntry.

v2.13.0 (June 2026) — superseded by 3.0.0, never published separately
- Additive (ADR-030, schema 1.2.0): Present (bool?) and Corroboration
  ("corroborated" | "reference-only" | "uncorroborated") on the runsheet entry.
  Entries are seeded from instrument documents physically present in the package
  (the implicit runsheet) and reconciled against indexed references; colliding
  sources corroborate (evidence merges) rather than being dropped.
- Additive: ChainGapCount on completeness (later renamed ReferenceOnlyCount in 3.0.0).
- Additive (ADR-029): ReadEngine ("documentai" | "gemini-vision", nullable) on
  TssEvidenceRef — the OCR-engine provenance axis. Omitted defaults to documentai.
  These changes shipped in the models but were never released under their own
  version; they are rolled into 3.0.0.

v2.12.0 (June 2026)
- Bumped TssExportSchema.Version to 1.1.0 (additive, backward compatible with 1.0.0)
- TssComplianceSearch.ResultCount (candidate match count for OFAC/Patriot searches)
  is now part of the formal 1.1.0 TSS export schema; the field already shipped in
  v2.11.0 so existing consumers require no code changes
- Expanded TSS population coverage upstream: state-court/Case.net name searches,
  CT field-per-section parcel aggregation, multi-entry OFAC searches, lowercase-keyed
  tax records, and CT transaction-history/instrument-reference chain rows (no SDK
  shape changes)

v2.11.0 (June 2026)
- Added TitleSearchSummaryExport and member types for normalized TSS export (TITL-1330)
- Added titleSearchSummary on JobResponse (GET /jobs/:id) and JobResults (persisted results)
- Added TssExportSchema.Version constant (1.0.0)
- Sample response and contract test for shell-phase TSS export

v2.10.0 (April 2026)
- Added normalizedFields.address_components (AddressComponents) — structured US address fields derived server-side from address (TITL-779)

v2.9.0 (April 2026)
- Normalized JUDGEMENT → JUDGMENT as the canonical document type (TITL-606)
- Added IsJudgment() helper method (checks DataType == "JUDGMENT")
- Deprecated IsJudgement() with [Obsolete] attribute — still works for both spellings
- Updated sample responses and contract tests for JUDGMENT

v2.8.0 (April 2026)
- Added AddressAnalysis to JobResults for cross-document address comparison (TITL-598)
- AddressAnalysis includes: UniqueAddresses, MultipleAddressesDetected, Comparisons
- Legal descriptions (lot/plat/subdivision references) are now filtered from address analysis
- Added AddressSource, AddressDocumentSource, AddressComparison classes
- Added HasMultipleProperties() and GetUniqueAddresses() helper methods on JobResults
- Non-breaking: existing v2.7.0 consumers will ignore the new optional field

v2.7.0 (March 2026)
- Added NormalizedFields to all structured extractions (first_party, second_party, document_date, etc.)
- Added RELEASE document type (satisfaction of mortgage, full reconveyance, release of lien)
- Added IsRelease() helper method
- Added ReleaseExtraction interface with fields matching release.md prompt
- Aligned extraction interfaces with AI prompts:
  - MORTGAGE: loan_amount → principal_amount
  - LIEN: debtor_name → property_owner
  - TAX_STATEMENT: fully restructured (owner_name → property_owner, parcel_number → parcel_id, etc.)
- Deprecated old field constants with [Obsolete] attributes (DebtorName, ParcelNumber, etc.)
- Added new StructuredFieldNames: PrincipalAmount, ParcelId, TotalAssessedValue, TotalTaxDue, etc.

v2.6.0 (February 2026)
- BREAKING: schedule_a_coverage and schedule_b_exceptions are now structured arrays (TITL-212)
- Added ScheduleAItem class (label, value) for Schedule A coverage terms
- Added ScheduleBExceptionItem class (description, type) for Schedule B exceptions
- Added GetScheduleACoverage() and GetScheduleBExceptions() helper methods
- Updated sample responses and contract tests

v2.5.0 (January 2026)
- Added PARTIAL_RELEASE, SECURITY_DEED, DEED_OF_TRUST, NOTICE_OF_COMPLETION document types
- Added ParcelItem class and GetParcels() helper for multi-parcel deeds
- Added JurisdictionInfo for state/county-aware processing

v2.3.0 (January 2026)
- Added COMMITMENT_FOR_POLICY document type (title commitments, ALTA policies)
- Added JUDGEMENT document type (court judgments)
- Added LAST_WILL_AND_TESTAMENT document type
- Fixed nullable TotalPages in PageNumberingContext
- Added contract tests for SDK validation

v2.2.0 (January 2026)
- Added CONSENT and APPOINTMENT document types
- Added sourcePage support for TITLE_SEARCH_SUMMARY sections
- Improved table extraction for large documents
